title: Playboy Magazine January 2002 Joanie Laurer Chyna Holiday Anniversary
conditionDescription: Pre-owned issue, complete. Normal signs of age and storage; possible cover wear, creases and edge/corner wear. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, January 2002 - Holiday Anniversary Issue. Cover price $6.99.

Features:
- "From Lady Wrestler to Warrior Princess" - Joanie Laurer (Chyna) Is Back Nude
- TV Goes To War: Playboy Interviews Brit Hume
- 20 Questions: super sportscaster Dan Patrick
- Fiction by Joyce Carol Oates and Robert Coover
- KISS superstar Gene Simmons tells the rock 'n' roll tales you dreamed about
- Playboy's Playmate Review; A Feverish Year in Sex
